notes.title: Where Is My Parking Spot - Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Once again here is a small update!

Change Log:

- Fixed Resolution duplicates once more.

- Added Highlight to your score on the leaderboards.
- Added "Previous Time" text to UI.
- Added Version number to menu.

- Changed leaderboards now show top 100
- Changed Cut scenes, they will only move on to the next level by the user. (Gives you time to get ready)

notes.title: Where Is My Parking Spot - Small Update
notes.notes:
Here is a small update for Where Is My Parking Spot.

Change Log:
[h3]
- Fixed Settings menu resolutions doubling up after applying the settings.
- Fixed SSRT staying on when viewing the garage.
- Fixed audio sliders not updating when changed.
- Fixed last level being too easy.

- Changed levels that have not been completed will now say "Not Completed" where the timer should be.
- Changed level 23, a few cars moved for better shortcuts.

- Added Steam leaderboards.
- Added Xbox controller support [Experimental | You can enable gamepad support in the settings]. 
- Added New skin for finishing all levels.
[/h3]

notes.title: Where Is My Parking Spot - Release Date!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38829300/3d5443a09cef8fc4b8b6d5e755cb0edad0e59a0d.png[/img]

[h1]Hello everyone! Where Is My Parking Spot now has a release date! November 10th![/h1]

[h2]What is coming with the full release?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Time Trials, Test your speed and beat your times! Good news, They get saved to the cloud!
[*] Many Parking Spots, Learn to park and conquer the spots!
[*] Car Skins, Pimp out your car with a new paint job.
[*] Many obstacles, You will hit them!
[*] 4 Chapters with 10 Crazy parking spots!
[/list]

[h2]What does the future hold for Where Is My Parking Spot?[/h2]

Where Is My Parking Spot has many cool and new things planned for the future, more chapters, more paint jobs and just all around more! Be sure to keep a look out for future updates as some could be huge and even add to the game!

[h2]Saying "Where Is My Parking Spot" seems too long.[/h2]

Don't worry about that! Just call the game W.I.M.P.S for short. November 10th, Get ready to find your parking spot!
